atoms.text: A person's identity is unique. It is the combination of various aspects of a person's life. Some of the components of our identity are:
atoms.sound: ssml: A person's identity is unique. It is the combination of various aspects of a person's life. Some of the components of our identity are <break time='500ms'/> our nationality, <break time='500ms'/> appearance, <break time='500ms'/> name, <break time='500ms'/> languages, <break time='500ms'/> hobbies and interests, <break time='500ms'/> character traits, <break time='500ms'/>goals <break time='500ms'/> and age.

atoms.text: My name is Elena. But I don't really like my name, so most of my friends call me Ell or Leni. I am 16 years old. As a matter of fact, I just turned 16 a few days ago, which makes me the youngest in my friendship group. I had a big party, where I celebrated my sweet sixteen with all my friends and family. I have brown eyes and until last week I had long brown hair, but I cut it off and dyed it pink. I really wanted to change my appearance, and finally got the permission to dye my hair after begging my parents for two weeks straight.

atoms.text: I was born and raised in Los Angeles, USA. However, my parents are from Mexico. They immigrated to the USA 20 years ago. That's why I see myself as a Mexican American. I love both the American and Mexican culture, but I definitely like the Mexican cuisine better. I speak two languages fluently, namely English and Spanish. Spanish is my mother tongue and I speak it with my siblings, parents and relatives. In contrast to that, I learnt English in preschool and I speak it with my friends. In school, I'm currently also learning French, which is quite interesting.

atoms.text: I am totally into music and art. I know every song by my favourite artists by heart and own a copy of all their albums. I have also been playing the guitar since I was 10 years old, and I joined the school band last year. On the other hand, I'm not athletic at all. My least favourite subject in school is P.E. In my last school report I had a D in P.E., which isn't surprising for me, but upsetting for my parents. My friends would say that I'm outgoing, since I'm never afraid of approaching and getting to know new people. I would describe myself as kind, because I like to help others out whenever I can. Moreover, I have a smile on my face most of the time.

atoms.text: I have many goals for my future. I want to be adventurous. Travelling to different countries and seeing the world is one of my dreams, especially South Africa. I also want to try out new things, like new hobbies, and things that I am afraid of, for instance bungee jumping. And I hope to be surrounded by people that bring me joy. While I'd love to stay in touch with my friends, I'd love to meet new people too.
